# Askeroo

A modern CLI prompt library that treats a terminal flow like a real, navigable form.

[TypeScript] [React] [Ink]

The first stateful CLI that allows back navigation. I created Askeroo after wishing more from the available prompt wizards that were avaiable. I wanted something modular and configurable for different needs.
Stateful back-navigation — revise earlier answers at any time
Conditional fields that respond to prior input
Built-in task runners for long-running steps
You can make prompts conditional by guarding them with conditions. In this example, the "Preferred language" prompt will only get shown if the "Developer" role is chosen.
A flow is simply an object made up of prompts. Run these prompts by calling the object with `ask()`.
